root_cause: Use of a blended pricing model that applies a higher flat rate than the underlying network cost.
diagnosis: The blended rate of 2.0% on Rs 1,989,154.65 yields Rs 39,783.09 in fees versus the true network cost rate of 1.75% (Rs 34,793.88), creating an overcharge of about Rs 4,989.21; this comparison uses an illustrative benchmark.
action_rationale: Switching to interchange‑plus pricing aligns fees with actual network rates, eliminating the overcharge.
